result.title: The Next Billion Jobs
result.description:
With millions of young people entering labour markets each year, particularly in emerging and developing economies, demographic expansion can either intensify unemployment and instability or become a powerful engine of productivity and innovation.

How can countries invest in high job-multiplier sectors to ensure that structural transformation delivers meaningful and productive employment?

result.title: What Next for the Middle East?
result.description:
After years of growing tensions, 2026 has amplified an uncertain path forward for the Middle East and relations within and outside the region. 

What are the possible paths forward and what could this mean for the world?

result.title: Robots in Rhythm with Us
result.description:
Robotics is slowly moving from the factory floor into the rhythms of everyday life, becoming helpful companions rather than machines on a factory floor. 

Explore how new advances in sensing, motion and learning are enriching the way we share space with technology, opening the door to a future where robots support our work, understand our environment and collaborate with us naturally in our homes, cities and communities.

result.title: The scientific advances ready to change the world: the Top 10 Emerging Technologies 2026
result.description:
Revolutionary healthcare treatments, a rethink of energy systems, and advances in AI, quantum and biotechnology: these are all among the breakthroughs contained in the latest Top 10 Emerging Technologies report.
We look at each of the technologies in the 14th annual Top 10 Tech report from the World Economic Forum.
Guest:
Kimmy Bettinger, Lead, Expert and Knowledge Communities, World Economic Forum

result.title: Ideas on the Move: Kaiser Kuo
result.description:
What does it take to truly understand another country? For Kaiser Kuo, Sinica podcast host and Chinese rock pioneer, it requires 'cognitive empathy' - an understanding that goes beyond emotion and helps us see how others experience the world.

First ride of #IdeasOnTheMove at Summer Davos #AMNC26
